steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Phew, this mission is finally over.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: We trained for long-distance operations, but the actual mission is a whole different thing.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: If we'd run another hour, my legs would've given out. What about you, Tila? Are you doing okay?
The mercenary stretched in the afternoon sun, then stopped and looked back at her teammate, who was only a few steps behind.
The Zalak girl seemed to have something on her mind, frequently looking around as she walked, but the moment she heard her companion's voice, she immediately offered a gentle smile.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I feel pretty good. It's probably because I usually walk long distances in the wild anyway.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Not bad. Even for a routine recon, the intensity is no joke, yet you still have energy to spare.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: It's not that big of a deal. As long as we complete the mission smoothly.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: By the way, you put that piece of candy in the lunch rations, right?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Yes. You mentioned when we were chatting earlier that you've always had a sweet tooth.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: After the morning recon, getting some sugar during the break can help relieve fatigue, making the rest of the operation easier.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: So I brought a piece for you.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Thank you so much.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Don't mention it. When you're out on missions, you actually encounter a lot of things that weren't covered in training, and it can get very dangerous if an emergency arises.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Helping others is what I should do. If anything, I feel like I haven't done enough.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Good thing we finished up early. How are you planning to relax once we get back, Tila? Watch a movie, or do something else?
Tila did not respond immediately, but instead looked thoughtfully toward the distant horizon, as if gazing at the silhouettes of several high-rise buildings on the edge of the wasteland.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Um... I don't know...
Her voice trailed off, but in the next instant, her eyes widened as if she had suddenly remembered something.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Oh, right!

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Is there something else?
Her teammate was a bit bewildered, scratching his head in confusion.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Sorry, you head back to the landship by yourself first. I'll write the report after I get back.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I just thought of something I have to go check out first. It won't take long.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: But aren't our missions already—

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: Oh! I get it! No need to explain, go on ahead.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Yeah, and I'm in a hurry. I won't have the chance if I wait. See you back at the landship!

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: It's not easy being the boss's right hand. On top of the daily missions, you have to take on extra work.

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: But... if I remember correctly, isn't that the military contractor's park over there?

steps.name: Blacksteel Scout
steps.text: What do we have to do with them anyway?
Only the empty landscape before sunset remained within the mercenary's visibility. He looked toward the distant office building and blinked in confusion.

a.name: group_location_stamp
a.time: Outside the main office building, Volvort Kochinski industrial park

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Halt.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: You aren't wearing a standard uniform with identification. If you're a visitor, please show your proof of appointment. Otherwise, entry is prohibited.
At the building entrance, a security guard stopped a Zalak girl who was walking straight in.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Hello, could you make an exception?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I'm just here to look around. I'll head up for a second and then be on my way.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Outside personnel without proof of appointment are not allowed to enter the office building.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Um... I can't provide any proof, but I need to go up there.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: If necessary, I can leave my weapons and gear here as collateral.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: This is very important to me. Could you please let me through?
The security guard sized up the visitor, and his tense body seemed to relax slightly.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: ...Intelligence personnel?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Yes, Blacksteel advance recon team.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Heading to the upper floors?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: That's right.
Hearing the girl's response, the security guard clearly breathed a sigh of relief. He then stepped aside, letting her through.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Go on up. Remember to keep your weapons put away and stay clear of the office areas. I'll notify the staff inside to coordinate with you.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: You have one hour at most. Strictly follow the rules.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Thank you. I'll be right back down.

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: (Whispering) Who knows what weird things the higher-ups are plotting now...

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: (Whispering) Always so secretive. They won't even let us keep records of the informants who come in...
The security guard watched the Zalak girl walk through the main entrance out of the corner of his eye, shaking his head to himself.
Inside the Volvort Kochinski office building, aside from the low hum of data storage machines, the sound of rapid footsteps echoed through the empty floors.
The Zalak girl did not linger on these floors at all, heading straight for the stairs leading to the upper levels.
The elevator had gone into stasis before reaching the fifteenth floor, so she had to cross an entire work area, push past the surprised crowd, and run into the stairwell to continue upward.
As long as I can get up there before it ends—
Miss! Please... stop!
A figure in a suit blocked her path, panting heavily. He bent over to support himself on the handrail, taking a few deep breaths before straightening up.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: ...Could you listen to me for a second?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: No matter what your purpose is here, you can't go any higher.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: The area above is strictly off-limits to outsiders. You've already violated the visitor regulations, so I must ask you to leave.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: But I still need to go up and take a look. I can't see what I want to see from just here.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Rest assured, I don't care about your company's affairs at all, nor do I care what you've been doing.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I'll leave immediately after I go up.
She prepared to continue upward, but the man in the suit in front of her quickly extended an arm to block her path.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Miss, I know you came here on missions, but I can't let you continue investigating our company.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Investigating? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I'm going to the rooftop. There's nothing there.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You still want to go to the upper level's Core Area?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: That's impossible, miss. You triggered the alarm the moment you left the visitor area.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: At the time, we could only put the passenger elevator into emergency stasis, but we didn't expect you to keep heading toward the Core Area.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Sir, let me reiterate, I have nothing to investigate.
The girl, in a hurry to go upstairs, took another step forward, but this time, instead of just reaching out a hand, the manager blocked the stairs with his entire body.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Take one more step and I'll notify security for the entire building. You won't be getting out of here in one piece.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Nobody wants to make a scene. Please leave here quickly before the situation upgrades—
Before the man standing at the top of the stairs could finish his sentence, the Zalak girl had already nimbly vaulted over the handrail.
In the blink of an eye, she was already striding toward the upper floors, leaving an echoing response in the stairwell.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Sorry, if I delay any longer, I really won't be able to see it! We can talk later!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: ...Won't be able to see? See what?
The manager stared blankly in the direction the girl had disappeared. Only after a few seconds did he react, raising the communicator in his hand.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Boss, we have an emergency!
Tila headed toward the higher floors, taking almost three steps at a time.
Unlike the floors where people were working, the sounds coming from outside the stairwell grew fainter. She could feel that she was getting closer and closer to the roof.
After climbing another floor, she saw the end of the stairs and the door leading to the roof. But at the same time, she also saw another person already waiting at the door.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Miss, I am one of the people in charge here.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Your investigation has caused quite a bit of chaos within the company, as well as many misunderstandings. How about you and I have one final negotiation to resolve this issue?
Tila slowed her pace as she walked up to the senior manager. She could see that his hand, propped on his cane, was trembling constantly.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Hello, sir. The misunderstanding is that I am not here to investigate, nor do I have any missions.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: At this point, why be so secretive?

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: I know you are Cliff's confidant. Although this is just a branch office of Volvort Kochinski, I still have a bit of say here.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: I believe both we and Blacksteel want things to settle down.
With that, the Volvort Kochinski representative extended his right hand and made a gesture.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Tell me what Cliff instructed you to do, and we can provide you with—

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: My actions have nothing to do with Mr. Cliff.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: ...Ha, I guess I oversimplified things.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Sir, it really is that simple. I am just going to your rooftop, and I will not do anything to harm your interests. I will leave immediately afterward.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Otherwise, think about it yourself—what kind of confidential information could I possibly see from the rooftop?

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: You are the one who came here with an ulterior motive! If I could guess what Cliff wanted, wouldn't I have just called him directly?!

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Do you think this is my first day dealing with agents like you?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: ...Why don't you give him a call right now then?

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Stop playing tricks—

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I don't have time to explain to you, sir. If we delay any longer, I will completely miss the beautiful view I want to see.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: If you insist on not believing me, why don't you come up to the roof with me and see for yourself?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I'll let you witness for yourself just how big of a misunderstanding there is between us.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: 'Beautiful view'? Hmph, so is that some kind of Blacksteel code word? What's the name of this operation? 'Operation Beautiful View'?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: ...It seems there's absolutely no getting through to you.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Although having someone whose head is entirely filled with corporate warfare tag along ruins the mood a bit, how about this?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Step aside and let me go up. In the meantime, you can keep an eye on me the entire time. If I do anything out of line, you can kick me out immediately.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Then I want you to, right now—

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: ...The deal isn't done yet, sir.
The senior manager stared intently into Tila's eyes, trying to weigh which was worse: letting this person onto the rooftop, or offending Cliff.
In the end, he stepped aside slightly.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: I agree, but I'll be watching you closely. Don't even think about taking a single thing from here!

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Don't worry, sir.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Then watch closely.
Tila walked toward the door leading to the rooftop and reached out to push it open.
At dusk, a gentle breeze blowing across the empty rooftop brushed against Tila's cheeks.
Today's sunset looked different from usual; in the somewhat dim sky, light scattered through the gaps in the clouds.
And those orange-red rays formed countless spaced-out pillars of light, illuminating the underside of the clouds and half of the darkening sky.
Tila stood at the doorway, looking at the light on the horizon, and let out a sigh of relief.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: How wonderful...

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: What is... this?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: A sunset, but not a normal sunset. Perhaps you can only see a sight like this once in many years.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Only on an afternoon that clears up after a dust storm, with perfect visibility, and the right cloud formations on the horizon...

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Only when all these conditions are met can the sunlight scatter in the air to create such a wonderful sight.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Although the way up wasn't easy, seeing such a rare sight makes it all worth it.
The senior manager stared at the dazzling beams of sunlight on the horizon, unable to hide the complex expression on his face.

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Is that it? Aren't you going to look for anything else?

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: Just looking at the sky and that's it?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Why should I do anything else?
She took a Rest as she walked toward the metal net, while the senior manager stood dazed behind her, unable to take a single step.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Compared to the people and things in this building, this beautiful view is what truly matters to me right now.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: The time and place to view it must be just right, and I have found the right place.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Look, while you were all busy looking for problems and answers that don't exist, the scenery changed again.
Tila reached out her hand, pointing toward the western horizon, and the senior manager couldn't help but follow her gesture, looking toward the horizon.
The sun had already set, but the afterglow still left a wonderful and dazzling light among the clouds, like bright flames rising from beneath the horizon.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: The timing is perfect, and the location is just as I imagined. This really is the best vantage point around.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I felt it the moment I laid eyes on this building. Only from the rooftop can you see this rare, once-in-a-lifetime view.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: No matter how you misunderstand my intentions, my only thought, from beginning to end, was simply to see this beautiful view.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Alright, I've finished everything I set out to do here. Do you understand my purpose now?

steps.name: Senior Manager
steps.text: This... but...
Tila looked at the senior manager, who still couldn't accept the situation, and shrugged.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: If you agree, may I leave now?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Landship, this is Tila from the recon team. Requesting support for our return.
In the fading light, the senior manager watched Tila finish her call, then let her walk past him toward the door.
Soon, the breathtaking scenery from moments ago vanished, leaving only a single person standing alone on the rooftop.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Tila, explain the situation.
The boss of Blacksteel pulled out a chair and sat down. He looked at Tila standing by the table; the girl's expression was very calm.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: On the way back to the landship, when I saw that building, it suddenly occurred to me that the rooftop would offer an excellent view.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Today, the missions happened to go quite smoothly and were finished before sunset. Plus, the weather was perfect—

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: So I wanted to go up and take a look. After all, the chance to see such a rare sight is extremely hard to come by.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I'm not asking you about that.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You are well aware of the chaos you caused this afternoon. Volvort Kochinski has been calling me nonstop, from their branch offices to their headquarters.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: I'm so sorry!

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: That kind of scattered afterglow will disappear if the conditions change even slightly. You can only catch a glimpse of it by going up to the roof at a very specific time.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: A sunset like that is hard to come across a second time, even if you actively look for it...
Cliff frowned as he looked at his assistant, but his solemn expression quickly softened.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Boss, if there's nothing else, I'll...

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Mr. Cliff—

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Since you've already relaxed, it just so happens that there is a very tricky mission right now that requires a capable hand. The briefing is here.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: A solo infiltration to be carried out almost entirely in underground passages. No sunset, no forests, not even natural caves...

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Boss, is this your way of getting back at me?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: The others who could complete the mission just happen to be away, that's all.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Haha...
Seeing that the Zalak girl had no intention of backing out, Cliff nodded to her and left the office.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Trading a rare sunset view for a boring and dangerous infiltration mission... I suppose that's a fair trade.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: And Mr. Cliff didn't even dock my vacation time this time. Could he actually be feeling good today?

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: ...Oh well, forget about that, I might as well just do as he says.

steps.name: Surfer
steps.text: Let's go.
